import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    grid = []
    index = 2
    for i in range(n):
        grid.append(data[index])
        index += 1
    
    r = int(data[index])
    c = int(data[index + 1])
    
    # Check RIGHT first
    if c + 1 < m and grid[r][c + 1] == '.':
        # Check if moving right brings closer to bottom-right
        if (r < n - 1) or (c + 1 < m - 1):
            print("RIGHT")
            return
    
    # Check DOWN
    if r + 1 < n and grid[r + 1][c] == '.':
        print("DOWN")
        return
    
    # Check LEFT
    if c - 1 >= 0 and grid[r][c - 1] == '.':
        print("LEFT")
        return
    
    # Check UP
    if r - 1 >= 0 and grid[r - 1][c] == '.':
        print("UP")
        return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
